title: viburnum urceolatum f. procumbens
intro: Viburnum urceolatum f. procumbens, commonly known as the procumbent Viburnum, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Adoxaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including the alleviation of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and its antimicrobial properties, which help combat infections and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Viburnum urceolatum f. procumbens include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
